name: ffuf
description: Fast web fuzzer written in Go

issues.title: Follow redirects while printing redirect chains
Option -ac is hiding valid results because of the way how auto-calibrated filters are applied.
ffuf fails to match / filter encoded content due Accept-Encoding header

latest_release.name: v2.3.0
latest_release.body:
## Changelog
* 256c1b02499f5f8672af965d4ad7a321d606bc65 Changelog: add v2.3.0, and backfill the v2.2.0 and v2.2.1 sections
* 90e28bd42efc4ee1f4e4645fc6920212ccd1ea2c Bound the -od/-audit-log response snapshot and the response header size (#934)
* 33c67d28c85b94589d029b3bcaff205a40cee9c4 Count response words/lines without allocating a []string (#930)
* 8162f48742ff140cafd0d8eb4f071714befccef5 Add preflight/postflight requests with variable extraction (#920)
* e43b4a239564e229d7469a957a8574bf25cc0fac Drop redundant security contact link from issue config (#919)
* a614addba3bf9327b115302dea1f5ac47a65c82a Add YAML issue forms routing to the wiki (#918)
* 89a493a1ca69c1c97ef3a0619880408f8d8a2507 Add SECURITY.md with a private disclosure policy (#917)
* c9e30e87c5c0c4826166507c656b9b6cc3b6f29f Add CONTRIBUTING.md and link the wiki engineering docs (#916)
* b3813a48ef35ee7ba326c22de1fd90f031272d71 Fix interactive console being scrolled off screen by inflight results (#915)
* 6658343f57113a821444256798f9663e519246ec refactor: split pkg/ffuf into a kernel + pkg/engine (#914)
* 047d6bf4fe63b0be4dfc516c0e2d499826c9b967 fix(scraper): FromDir reads its dirname argument, not the global SCRAPERDIR (#913)
* a4c162c6f04c04369e6733c0b367dcf243821d94 refactor: drop the single-implementation by-name factories (#912)
* f9626f7a08fc1d53b234ea72840a75ce656ac1d6 refactor(ffuf): extract recursion policy into a recursionManager (#911)
* 517c3593da9ebdd9219ca465767738a4a80b8be0 Structural refactor: testable assembly, match seam, per-job context (#910)
* e0e54ce8428db0297b3d1d6cb2dba58aa55ad188 Fix concurrency defects: MatcherManager, recursion queue, pause gate, and related races (#909)
* b6b87a4baed29cbb15994e882e8213b2c1f1f8f3 Testing suite: mock-target integration harness + engine race fixes (#906)
* d06edaabbfc04b9d019917ba68518a2e04b2d9d3 fix: synchronize Stdoutput result accumulation (#908)
* 4086e56e16eeadcf11c570170edd75e104cae3b6 fix: autocalibration mutated the caller's input map (#907)
* 8e9c5e65f655363d477b8ff5080f84130b66b5eb Declarative flag/config architecture: add a flag = one tagged field (#904)
* 0acfcc58de63062cf940d95d94ed9e0eddade4f6 Fix terminal control characters leaking into redirected output (#905)
* 70cbcc10ddbef10a66bce3aa473d4ea04700f63f Add Winget and Scoop installation instructions (#797)
* b0fbfb90b0ca54af54c079a2c761cdf1f78bde24 Updated README.md (#903)
